Title: Verify the new QR Bangla configuration properties are correctly bound and accessible in the application
Section: QR Bangla Configuration - Property Binding and Validation
Preconditions: Application is deployed with the updated application.yml file. No environment variable QR_SIGNING_KEY is set (default fallback should be used).
Steps:
1. Start the application in the default profile. 2. Trigger a QR code generation request for a merchant with Bangla QR enabled. 3. Inspect the generated QR code data or application logs to confirm the properties are used.

Test Data: New properties: qr.bangla.guid='com.my.uuid', qr.bangla.signing-key='1234ABCD9876ZXCV' (fallback), qr.bangla.signature-length=16
Expected Result: The application starts successfully. The generated QR code includes the GUID 'com.my.uuid' and a signature of length 16, using the fallback signing key '1234ABCD9876ZXCV'.

Title: Verify the QR_SIGNING_KEY environment variable overrides the default value in the configuration
Section: QR Bangla Configuration - Environment Variable Override
Preconditions: Application is deployed with the updated application.yml file. Environment variable QR_SIGNING_KEY is set to a valid value (e.g., 'TESTKEY1234567890').
Steps:
1. Start the application in the default profile. 2. Trigger a QR code generation request for a merchant with Bangla QR enabled. 3. Inspect the generated QR code data or application logs to confirm the environment variable is used.

Test Data: Environment variable QR_SIGNING_KEY='TESTKEY1234567890' vs. default fallback '1234ABCD9876ZXCV'
Expected Result: The application starts successfully. The generated QR code uses the signing key 'TESTKEY1234567890' instead of the default fallback value.

Title: Verify the application fails to start if the QR_SIGNING_KEY environment variable is missing and no default is provided (dev profile)
Section: QR Bangla Configuration - Missing Environment Variable Validation
Preconditions: Application is deployed with the updated application.yml file. Environment variable QR_SIGNING_KEY is not set. Application is configured to run in a profile where the default fallback is removed or invalid (e.g., empty).
Steps:
1. Attempt to start the application in the dev profile. 2. Observe the application startup logs.

Test Data: Environment variable QR_SIGNING_KEY is not set. Default fallback is '1234ABCD9876ZXCV' (but test with fallback removed or invalid).
Expected Result: The application fails to start and logs an error indicating that the required environment variable QR_SIGNING_KEY is missing or invalid.

Title: Verify the application enforces the signature length specified in the configuration
Section: QR Bangla Configuration - Signature Length Validation
Preconditions: Application is deployed with the updated application.yml file. QR_SIGNING_KEY is set to a valid value (e.g., 'TESTKEY1234567890').
Steps:
1. Start the application in the default profile. 2. Trigger a QR code generation request for a merchant with Bangla QR enabled. 3. Inspect the generated QR code signature length.

Test Data: qr.bangla.signature-length=16
Expected Result: The generated QR code signature is exactly 16 characters long.

Title: Verify the GUID specified in the configuration is included in the generated QR code data
Section: QR Bangla Configuration - GUID Validation in QR Data
Preconditions: Application is deployed with the updated application.yml file. QR_SIGNING_KEY is set to a valid value.
Steps:
1. Start the application in the default profile. 2. Trigger a QR code generation request for a merchant with Bangla QR enabled. 3. Parse the generated QR code data to confirm the GUID is present.

Test Data: qr.bangla.guid='com.my.uuid'
Expected Result: The generated QR code data includes the GUID 'com.my.uuid' as part of its structure.

Title: Verify the QR Bangla configuration is correctly loaded in the prod profile
Preconditions: Application is deployed with the updated application.yml and application-prod.yml files. QR_SIGNING_KEY is set to a valid value for prod.
Steps:
1. Start the application in the prod profile. 2. Trigger a QR code generation request for a merchant with Bangla QR enabled. 3. Inspect the generated QR code data or logs to confirm the properties are used.

Test Data: Profile: prod. Expected properties: qr.bangla.guid, qr.bangla.signing-key, qr.bangla.signature-length.
Expected Result: The application starts successfully. The generated QR code uses the GUID, signing key, and signature length specified in the prod profile configuration.
